invoice_clauses.11.1: Each invoice quotes the contract number on the face of this Agreement and carries an invoice number unique across the term.
invoice_clauses.11.2: Every Service Date falls within the term stated in Section 2.1 and may not fall after the invoice date.
invoice_clauses.11.3: The same Service may not be billed twice for the same Patient and the same Service Date, whether on one invoice or across several. Section 6.2 applies to any attempt to do so.

conventions.1.1: "Service Day" means the calendar day recorded as the Service Date of the line item.
conventions.2.2: All Services are delivered from Main Campus (F-MAIN); no facility differential arises under this Agreement and plan tier does not affect the rate.
conventions.4.1: Where more than one adjustment applies to the same Service, the adjustments shall be applied to the base rate strictly in the following order: (a) substitution of a bundled rate; (b) the facility multiplier; (c) the plan-tier multiplier; (d) any premium or uplift; and (e) any cumulative volume discount. The line total is then the resulting unit rate multiplied by the billed quantity.
conventions.4.2: All monetary amounts are expressed in whole cents. Where the application of a multiplier, premium or discount produces a fraction of a cent, the result shall be rounded to the nearest whole cent, with exact halves rounded away from zero ("half up"). Rounding is applied after each individual step of the calculation, not once at the end.
conventions.4.3: Adjustments are applied successively and are not compounded within a single class. In particular, where two thresholds in Section 8 are exceeded, only the deeper discount is applied; the two are not multiplied together.
conventions.4.4: The line total is the effective unit rate produced by this Section multiplied by the quantity billed. The invoice total is the sum of the line totals on the invoice and nothing else.
conventions.5.1: Where the aggregate quantity of a Service delivered to a Patient on a single Service Day exceeds the threshold stated below, the uplift stated below applies to that Service Day. The threshold is assessed against the aggregate for the Service Day and not against any single line item.
conventions.5.3: Nothing in this Section limits Section 6; a premium may be payable on a quantity which is itself subject to the limit in that Section.
conventions.6.1: The following limits apply to the quantity of a Service that may be billed for one Patient on one Service Day. A quantity in excess of the limit is not payable, and the excess is not recoverable by re-presenting it on a later invoice.
conventions.6.2: A limit in this Section applies irrespective of the number of line items or invoices across which the quantity is presented.
conventions.7.1: Where both Services in a pair listed below are delivered to the same Patient on the same Service Day, the pair is billed at the substituted rates shown, in place of the base rates in Section 3. The substitution occurs first in the order set out in Section 4.1.
conventions.7.2: Where only one Service of a pair is delivered on a Service Day, the base rate in Section 3 applies to it and no substitution occurs.
conventions.8.3: Where cumulative utilisation of a Service exceeds the number of instances stated below, a discount of the percentage stated below shall apply to subsequent instances of that Service. Where a Service appears more than once below, the deeper discount applies once its threshold has been exceeded.
conventions.8.4: A discount under Section 8.3 applies to a line item where the cumulative utilisation prior to that line item exceeds the threshold. It does not apply to the line item on which the threshold is first crossed.
conventions.8.5: For the purposes of Section 8.3, utilisation is counted in Service Date order, and where two line items share a Service Date they are counted in ascending order of line identifier.
conventions.9.1: A Service listed below is not billable where the Service shown against it has been delivered to the same Patient within the stated number of days of the Service Date, measured in either direction. This Section applies irrespective of Section 8.3 and irrespective of whether the two Services appear on the same invoice.
